content: Drizzle ORM enum best practice: pgEnum creates a real PostgreSQL ENUM type; adding values is supported, but REMOVING a value requires a table rebuild workaround and fails if the column has a default. Community consensus leans 'never use enums on db level while dealing with drizzle, use them on code level'. varchar with zod/class-validator enums at the API boundary is the repo-consistent, migration-flexible choice (CatLium uses varchar(length) everywhere).
